text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help bring your startup idea to life.

With 6 years of experience building machine learning and NLP solutions, I can help you turn your logic into a working product with the right structure, reliability, and user experience. Your two projects are both very aligned with my background: a chatGPT-style app with special features, and a QA bot builder based on GPT-3. I’m comfortable working across Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’ve built systems that need careful prompt handling, search, and answer quality.

One project I worked on was a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. The system reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project required strong attention to reliability, retrieval quality, and clear user-facing behavior — all important for the kind of GPT-based tools you’re describing.

For your Bubble build, I can help think through the product logic, AI integration points, and the structure needed for both the chatGPT clone and the QA bot builder. If your logic is already ready, I can focus on implementing the functionality cleanly and making sure the AI features behave consistently. I’m especially comfortable with workflows that involve document-based Q&A, LLM orchestration, and building practical machine learning features into user-facing apps.

I’d be glad to discuss your startup idea, understand the special features you want in the chat experience, and map out how the QA bot builder should work end to end. If you’re looking for someone who can build carefully and help turn a clear concept into a usable product, I’d be excited to work with you.
